title: Financial Automation Specialist – Profit-Tech
description:
Este é um cargo remoto.
A Profit-Tech está em busca de um(a) Financial Automation Specialist para integrar o time responsável por transformar processos financeiros em sistemas automatizados e inteligentes.
O objetivo é garantir eficiência, precisão e controle estratégico por meio da automação e integração entre plataformas financeiras, como Zoho One e AWS .
Principais responsabilidades:

• Implementar e otimizar módulos financeiros no Zoho Books, Analytics e Flow .

• Criar relatórios automatizados de Lucros e Perdas (P&L) , Fluxo de Caixa e Balanço Patrimonial .

• Integrar dados financeiros de bancos, planilhas e sistemas em dashboards inteligentes.

• Automatizar rotinas de controle de despesas, receitas e conciliações bancárias.

• Apoiar a equipe de Cloud e ERP na integração entre AWS e relatórios financeiros.

• Desenvolver templates e relatórios reutilizáveis para clientes e parceiros.

• Trabalhar diretamente com a diretoria da Profit-Tech na identificação de gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria.

• Documentar processos e criar tutoriais de automação financeira para uso interno e treinamentos.

Requirements
⚙️

Requirements

• Experiência de 3 a 6 anos em finanças corporativas, controladoria ou automação financeira.

• Conhecimento sólido em Zoho Books, Zoho Analytics e Zoho Flow .

• Capacidade de interpretar relatórios financeiros e traduzir dados em automações práticas.

• Conhecimento de Deluge Script , integrações via API e FinOps .

• Perfil analítico, organizado e com atenção aos detalhes.

• Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar remotamente.

• Inglês técnico ou português fluente.

Diferenciais:

• Experiência com AWS Cost Explorer, QuickSight ou Power BI .

• Conhecimento em ERP, CRM e automação de processos empresariais .

• Capacidade de criar materiais didáticos ou participar de treinamentos internos.

title: Full-Stack Platform Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Every organization runs on intelligence: years of accumulated knowledge, decisions, and context. As AI takes on more of that work, companies face a choice: rent that intelligence from vendors who keep the data, the context, and the results, or own it.

OpenTeams exists to make ownership possible.

Founded by Travis Oliphant, creator of NumPy and SciPy, and built by people with deep roots across the open-source ecosystem, including NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch, and Jupyter, we help enterprises and governments build AI they control, govern, and evolve themselves.

If that sounds like your kind of work, we'd like to meet you.

Full-Stack Platform Engineer x2

Location: U.S - Remote OR Hybrid - Washington, DC, Denver, CO or Colorado Springs, CO.
Work Authorization: U.S. citizenship required
Clearance: U.S.-Remote Opening: An active clearance is not required. Candidates must be eligible and willing to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. Hybrid Opening: An active TS/SCI clearance is preferred. Candidates may also be considered if they previously held a TS/SCI with CI polygraph or currently hold an active TS or Secret clearance.
Salary Range: $145,000-$250,000 USD, dependent on experience level and location
Openings: Two positions are available:

•
One hybrid position: Candidates must be located in or willing to work hybrid from Washington, DC; Denver, CO; or Colorado Springs, CO. An active TS/SCI clearance is required. Up to 15% travel is required.

•
One U.S.-remote position : Candidates may work remotely from anywhere in the United States. An active clearance is not required, but candidates must be willing and able to undergo the process required to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

Candidates will be considered for the opening that best aligns with their location, clearance status, experience, and work preferences. Candidates who meet the requirements for multiple openings may be considered for more than one.
About the Role
We're looking for a Full-Stack Platform Engineer to build both sides of an AI platform - the API surface other teams build on, and the interfaces analysts use directly.
The API comes first here, and that's a real constraint rather than a slogan: platform capabilities are consumed through documented interfaces by analysts, internal teams, and partner organizations using their own tools. If those interfaces are unstable or hard to reason about, adoption stalls regardless of what the platform can do underneath.
On the backend, you build API-first services for workflow orchestration, data ingestion, evaluation execution, and results management, and you implement identity federation and access controls that hold up across deployment environments. On the frontend, you build the analyst-facing tooling - modern web consoles and utilities where someone actually kicks off a workflow, inspects a result, or figures out why a run failed. You should be comfortable in a component-based web stack, though the emphasis is on clear, functional interfaces over visual polish. Doing both sides means you feel your own API design decisions from the consuming side, which is the fastest way to find the ones that were wrong.
You also produce what external teams need to build on the platform: documentation, reference implementations, and client examples that work when someone follows them.
Key Responsibilities

• Design, implement, document, and maintain APIs for workflow orchestration, data ingestion, evaluation execution, and results management

• Define clear, stable, and versioned interface specifications for use by external integrators

• Implement brokered single sign-on and identity federation using protocols such as OpenID Connect, SAML, and PKI/X.509 certificate-based authentication

• Enforce approved authentication, authorization, and access-control requirements across platform services

• Design relational data models that support platform APIs and workflow requirements

With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

title: 2027 Summer Intern, Perception - Evaluation
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Perception team builds the system which learns the spatial-temporal representation and their semantic meanings of the surrounding environment of the self-driving car, i.e., the system that “perceives” the world around the car. We work jointly with downstream teams on the optimization and integration into the Waymo Driver. We conduct our own research to address real-world problems and collaborate with research teams at Alphabet.  We have access to millions of miles of driving data from a diverse set of sensors, enabling engineers like you to (1) develop methods for efficiently and continuously learning from large scale real-world data, to (2) develop models and model training at scale, to (3) analyze real-world behavior and develop systems for handling the complexities of interacting with the real-world, and (4) optimize models for our onboard and offboard hardware. 

Waymo interns work with leaders in the industry on projects that deliver significant impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skillset. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship!

This internship will be based on-site at our headquarters in Mountain View, CA.

 

You will:

• Improve signal quality in large scale perception evaluation workflows using generative AI (LLM/VLM)

• Expand the capabilities of discovery evaluation system to cover a broader range of perception signals

• Contribute to design and development of frameworks and methods for evaluating multi-task perception models

• Collaborate with ML and infra engineers to integrate new signals to end-to-end model launch evaluation

• Evaluate the impact of improvements on evaluation quality, focusing on precision, recall, and reliability

 

You have:

• Proficiency with coding in Python or C++ and navigating large codebases

• Experience with building and/or evaluating machine learning models

• Experience with data analysis and statistical evaluation

• Enrolled in a Masters or PhD program in Computer Science, Robotics, or a similar technical field of study

 

We prefer:

• Multi-year C++ experience with contributions to large code bases or open source projects

• Familiarity with perception models, in particular with object generation and semantics tasks

• Experience in utilizing AI-powered workflows for data analysis or model evaluation

• Experience in applying machine learning concepts and evaluation methodologies

• Proven experience in building data and evaluation pipelines and processing large-scale datasets

 

Note: This will be a hybrid onsite internship position. We will accept resumes on a rolling basis until the role is filled. To be in consideration for multiple roles, you will need to apply to each one individually - please apply to the top 3 roles you are interested in.

title: Plant Controls Lead (EMS/PPC)
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE POWER GENERATION TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Build an islanded grid at gigawatt scale, from a blank sheet. Generation, storage and compute running with no utility behind them, where the machine you design is the only thing holding frequency. No playbook exists at this size, so the architecture you set becomes the reference.

- Get power online in months, not years. Interconnection queues are measured in years and we do not have them. Generating our own power is how a site goes from signed lease to live compute inside six months, and the power system is the long pole in that plan.

- Make one power block, then build it a thousand times. A repeatable block and cluster unit, validated once and stamped across the fleet, is the only route to the scale we are targeting. Every bespoke site is schedule we do not get back.

- Design a grid whose largest load answers back. Compute is not passive demand here. Load behaviour, curtailment and shedding are design variables you negotiate and specify, a lever almost no power system engineer has ever been handed.

ROLE SCOPE

- Own the control stack for fully off-grid campuses, the site energy management system, the plant controller for each power block and the dispatch logic across PV, BESS and gas, as one standard architecture that scales from a single block to a GW-scale campus energized in six months.

- Turn the control philosophy into sequences of operation our own code executes, covering every operating mode, source transition, blackstart path, emergency shed and degraded state, with each one proven in simulation and hardware-in-the-loop before the plant is energized.

- Hold the generation side of the control contract between the power plant and the data center, and extend it from one plant and one facility to many blocks feeding many buildings, with load reduction deadlines measured in seconds that both sides are measured against in production.

- Decide which components we bring in to energize the first campuses faster and which we build first, then replace each bought piece with our own code on a planned schedule, holding every supplier to our specification and conformance tests so Fluidstack keeps its configuration, its data and a clean exit.

We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Role:
We’re looking for a VP-level AI Architect to define and drive a consistent, modern AI- and agentic-first architecture across CrowdStrike. This company-wide role spans business units, customer-facing products, shared platforms, and internal AI capabilities.

You’ll connect AI applications with the software and infrastructure that make them work at scale. Working with business unit and engineering leaders, you’ll translate business priorities into practical designs, establish common technical foundations, and guide implementation across teams. The architecture must support distinct product needs while making shared capabilities easier to build, integrate, and operate.

Your work will range from company-wide architectural decisions to building reference implementations and resolving difficult engineering problems. You’ll bring deep systems expertise, sound judgment about emerging AI technologies, and a record of turning architectural direction into working products.

What You’ll Do:

• Define and drive the company-wide AI architecture and roadmap. Establish shared interfaces and design patterns, resolve cross-business-unit tradeoffs, and work with product and engineering leaders to put architectural decisions into practice. Determine which capabilities should be common and where teams need flexibility.

• Design and build full-stack AI and agentic systems. Connect models and retrieval to agent runtimes, memory, tools, and execution environments. Develop prototypes and production reference implementations that give teams a tested foundation for new capabilities.

title: Forward-Deployed Integrations Engineer
description:
Reports to: Chief Technology Officer
Location: Burlington, VT (hybrid) or remote (no formal travel required)
About OhMD

OhMD is an AI patient communication platform trusted by thousands of healthcare organizations. Our product suite includes two-way patient texting, an AI voice and text assistant that handles inbound patient calls with a human always in the loop, and integrations with the leading ambulatory EHRs, including athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, DrChrono, Elation, and Healthie.
Practices using OhMD reduce inbound call volume by 50% or more, which is the difference between a front desk that is drowning and one that can actually take care of patients.
Why this role exists
Every healthcare organization operates on a unique technology stack.
One EHR exposes a clean FHIR endpoint. Another has a vendor-specific API with its own authentication and rate limits. A third has no supported API at all for the scheduling, patient, or clinical data our product needs. Even practices on the same EHR configure it differently, enforce different security requirements, and run entirely different front-desk workflows.

OhMD still has to work.
Our products need accurate patient context, appointment data, and workflow state to resolve conversations safely. Our AI voice and text assistant cannot book, confirm, or reschedule an appointment it cannot see. Those integrations have to be reliable enough to support real patient interactions, secure enough to handle protected health information, and understandable enough that our customers trust what is happening.
Which brings us to the hard part, and to you.
This role owns the path between a practice's real-world workflow and a working production integration. You'll sit with customers, understand how their systems actually operate, choose the right integration approach, build it, test it, launch it, and stay with it until it works cleanly.
Today that footprint spans more than a dozen EHRs. Our deepest integrations are athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, DrChrono, Elation, and Healthie, and they run across three codebases: a .NET service that handles patient sync and chart write-back, an Elixir platform that handles scheduling and reminders, and a TypeScript and Playwright service for systems that don't offer a usable API. You won't need to be expert in all three on day one, but you will need to be comfortable reading and shipping in each.
Sometimes the right answer will be a vendor REST API or a FHIR application. Sometimes there will be no usable interface at all, and you'll build production-grade browser automation to retrieve the data OhMD needs.
This is not a role where you write a specification and hand it to someone else. You'll be the engineer in the customer conversation and the customer-facing owner in the code.
What your first 90 days look like
Weeks 1-4: Live in the product. Learn how OhMD connects to EHRs today, shadow customer discovery sessions and go-lives, and understand how patient, scheduling, and workflow data move through the platform. Get familiar with our integrations across EHRs.
Weeks 5-8: Own your first integration with support. Scope the customer’s requirements, select the right technical path, build or configure the integration, validate the data, and support the customer through testing. Ship something that runs against a real production workflow.
Weeks 9-12: Lead an integration workstream independently. Own technical discovery, implementation, validation, launch, and early production support. Bring us a point of view on what should become a reusable connector, what belongs in shared infrastructure, and where our current approach will break at scale.
Essential Duties - What You’ll Own
Customer integrations, start to finish
You’ll work directly with healthcare organizations, EHR vendors, internal implementation teams, and engineering partners to understand what a customer needs and how their systems behave.
You’ll translate operational workflows into concrete technical requiremen

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare erste Erfahrung im Outbound-Sales inkl. Kaltakquise.

- Hohe Selbststeuerung und Eigenverantwortung - du gehörst zu den ersten Teammitgliedern vor Ort.

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Eine Führungskraft und Kolleg:innen, die dich jederzeit unterstützen.

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Risk Engineering
description:
WHO WE ARE

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com http://Booking.com, H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

Risk Engineering owns the systems that execute Imprint's risk decisions in real time: transaction authorization and fraud scoring on every card swipe, the underwriting pipeline that evaluates every application, and the vendor integrations that power both. These are latency-sensitive, high-stakes distributed systems with a sprawling surface area and many stakeholders competing for the team's capacity. AI has made execution faster; the differentiator is the judgment to decide what to build, how to sequence it, and when to say no. That judgment, applied to a strong team and a hard domain, is what this Senior Engineering Manager owns.

THE OPPORTUNITY

- Own real-time authorization and fraud decisioning: Every card swipe runs through systems your team builds. Decisions happen in milliseconds, failures are visible immediately, and a wrong answer costs real money in either direction: fraud losses on one side, declined good customers on the other. You set the bar for how these systems are designed, tested, and operated.

- Own the underwriting pipeline: Every application Imprint receives is evaluated by the pipeline your team owns, spanning credit, fraud, identity, and compliance checks. As Imprint launches new brand partners and new products, the pipeline has to absorb new policies and new data sources without becoming brittle.

- Make vendor decisions that hold up in production: Fraud scoring, identity verification, and bureau data all run through third-party integrations. You'll evaluate vendor capabilities, weigh build-versus-buy with real latency and cost numbers, and push back on approaches that won't survive production load.

- Prioritize across a wide surface cross-functional surface area: Credit, Fraud, Product, and Compliance all have legitimate asks and compete for the same engineering capacity. You'll bring clarity to poorly-scoped platform problems, decide what the team does and does not take on, and make the reasoning legible to stakeholders who didn't get what they asked for. You define the roadmap and scope the work yourself; nothing is abstracted through organizational layers.

- Lead with technical credibility, amplified by AI: AI has collapsed the distance between management and IC work. Managers at Imprint use AI tools to investigate codebases, assess the complexity and viability of work, and bring clarity to ambiguous asks. You don't need to be on the critical path writing code (though some managers are), but you need the technical judgment to evaluate design trade-offs on latency-sensitive distributed systems and the modern tools to exercise it.

- Lead a strong team as a craft: You inherit a strong, psychologically safe team of senior engine

Hawk-Eye Innovations is at the forefront of sports technology, delivering officiating, tracking, broadcast and performance solutions across some of the world's biggest sports. What if athletes, coaches and teams could access the kind of tracking technology that has traditionally been out of reach?

We’re building a new generation of tracking services for elite and semi-professional sport, creating products that bring powerful technology to the people who need it most.

We’re looking for a Senior Android Engineer to take ownership of the mobile application at the heart of this experience.

You’ll join a small, cross-functional engineering team building something new, with the opportunity to shape the architecture, influence technical decisions and see your work make a tangible difference. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

Your mission

As a Robotic Sales Engineer (RSE), you are RobCo’s technical face to the customer and the technical lead on every deal you own, from the first customer call to a handover-ready solution. You work as a team with our Account Executives, and every technical question on the deal runs through you. You carry a quota together with your AE, and you win deals as a team.

- Scaled something from zero: a site, a market, a process or a program.

- Managed a physical operation: quick commerce, grocery, e-commerce fulfillment, last mile, 3PL, food production, airport ground handling, rail. Anywhere with a hard cut off and people on the floor.

- Communicate in both directions and have strong people management skills: you can brief 80 operatives at shift start and take a problem to senior leadership the same day.

- Built a mechanism that held: a control, a cadence, a metric, a document standard. Something you authored that changed how frontline teams worked.

- Understand frontline work: one of these must be true: you have personally led frontline teams; you have worked embedded in and around a frontline population day to day, without the reporting line; or you have been accountable for outcomes delivered by frontline people you did not employ.

title: Security Engineer, Exposure and Vulnerability Management
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE SECURITY TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- You're securing the frontier of AI. The model weights training on our infrastructure are the most valuable and most targeted artifacts in technology, and we're standing up the compute to hold them faster than anyone ever has. A breach isn't a leak, it's the frontier walking out the door.

- Build the entire security program from scratch. Most leaders inherit someone else's system and spend a career patching it. Here you own it end to end, bare metal to boardroom, as we scale across continents.

- Your threat surface is measured in gigawatts. The customers running on our infrastructure are building the most consequential technology in human history, and being responsible for the physical and logical security of that work makes everything else feel small.

ROLE SCOPE

- Own exposure and vulnerability management across the estate: external attack surface, cloud and Kubernetes, corporate endpoints, network infrastructure, and the bare-metal fleet beneath them.

- Extend exposure and vulnerability management across the corporate fleet (macOS, Windows, Linux): OS and application patch posture, first-party and third-party software, and drift from approved baselines.

- Cover software outside our managed and approved catalogs: unmanaged apps and SaaS, package-level software on endpoints (npm, PyPI, Homebrew), and browser and IDE extensions. Identify it, assess it, and drive it to remediation or removal.

- Build the engineering that makes it work: asset inventory, scanner orchestration, deduplication, and prioritization built on reachability and real-world exploitation rather than raw CVSS.

- Engineer remediation into the workflows teams already use, so findings land as owned tickets, fixes ride existing pipelines, and closure verifies automatically.

- Remediate alongside the teams that own the systems: write the patch PR, harden the base image, fix the IaC module, and ship the config change rather than just requesting it.

- Extend the program past where enterprise playbooks run out: BMC and device firmware, GPU drivers, host images at fleet scale, and the long tail of data center equipment.

- Run intake for pen test findings and external reports, and report exposure honestly: what's reachable, what's exploited in the wild, what's accepted and by whom.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You will work on the systems that make autonomous science possible: automated workcells, custom instrumentation, sensing hardware, motion systems, and integrated lab equipment.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who wants to build real hardware in a fast-moving R&D environment. You will move between mechanical design, electrical integration, prototyping, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting, working alongside engineers and scientists to turn lab needs into reliable engineering systems.

Your work will support the next generation of lab automation at Lila, helping improve the reliability, scalability, and performance of systems used across our scientific programs. You will leave the term with practical experience across the full mechatronics stack, from concept and CAD through build, test, and iteration.

What You'll Be Building

• Design and build mechanical and electromechanical components for automated lab systems.

• Support integration of sensors, actuators, motion systems, and control hardware.

• Create CAD models, drawings, prototypes, fixtures, and test setups.

• Assemble, debug, and iterate on hardware for workcells and custom instrumentation.

• Run tests, document results, and communicate design changes clearly.

• Collaborate with engineers and scientists to translate lab workflows into reliable systems.

• Contribute to improvements that increase system reliability, usability, and maintainability.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Currently pursuing a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related field.

• Experience with CAD design, prototyping, fabrication, or hands-on engineering projects.

• Foundational understanding of mechanical systems, electrical systems, sensors, actuators, or controls.

• Comfortable building, testing, debugging, and documenting physical systems.

• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail in hands-on technical work.

• Clear communication skills and ability to collaborate across engineering and scientific teams.

• Curiosity about lab automation, instrumentation, robotics, or autonomous science.

Bonus Points For

• Experience with SolidWorks or another parametric CAD tool.

• Exposure to electrical wiring, instrumentation, controls, or data acquisition systems.

• Experience with robotics, lab automation, industrial automation, or motion systems.

• Familiarity with 3D printing, machining, sheet metal, or rapid prototyping methods.

• Previous internship, co-op, lab, project team, or R&D experience.

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

In this role, you will partner directly with enterprise customers to design optimal product implementation strategies, evaluate risk profiles, and align Jumio’s technical solutions with customer’s unique business objectives.

The Identity Strategist owns the critical onboarding mission for new deployments. Acting as a strategic advisor, you are directly responsible for driving efficient customer onboarding and rollout, and overcoming regulatory, legal, or operational hurdles to accelerate time-to-live and maximize time-to-value while ensuring solution adoption and long-term trust.

• Project Management skills and the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams from Product, Engineering, Legal/Compliance to deliver outcomes for Jumio customers

• Ability to distill complex, technical fraud concepts into clear, value-driven narratives for executive stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with identity verification, fraud, compliance, fintech, or enterprise software solutions

• Technical understanding of APIs, integrations, SaaS platforms, or implementation methodologies

• Project management certification or equivalent experience

• Experience working with global enterprise customers

Compensation:

We offer an annual full-time salary (38.5 hr week) of min 80,000 EUR gross, with a possible overpayment depending on qualifications and experience.
Jumio Values:

IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation

Equal Opportunities :

Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.

About Jumio:

Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders. 

Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.

About Lexroom

Lexroom http://lexroom.ai/ is building the AI platform where legal work gets done. In just over two years, we've grown from zero to €25M ARR, and today more than 20,000 legal professionals across Italy, Spain, Germany, France, and Bulgaria rely on Lexroom http://lexroom.ai/.

We're backed by $73M from Left Lane Capital, Base10 Partners, and Eurazeo, and we're a team of around 300 builders who move fast, say things straight, and own each outcome.

Our next goal? Become Europe's most-used legal product.

The role

You’ll partner a group of teams across Lexroom and report to our Head of People. Your managers will bring you their hardest people questions: how to grow their teams, keep their best people, handle difficult conversations, pay fairly, and organise their teams as they scale.

Every Lexroom employee has two People contacts. People Operations takes care of contracts, payroll and admin. You take care of everything about managing, growing and keeping people.

We’re also running our core HR cycles for the first time, so you’ll help design them as well as run them.

What you’ll do

- Own the people agenda for your client group

- Run performance, engagement, compensation and promotion cycles, and help improve how we run them

- Shape how your teams are organised as they grow: structures, roles, reporting lines, reorgs

- Coach managers on their teams and on difficult conversations

- Handle employee relations, from probation reviews to disciplinary matters

- Give Talent Acquisition and People Operations the business context they need to do their job well

- Turn what you see and hear into clear insights for the Head of People and leadership

Things we really care about

- You understand the business before you advise on its people: what each team does and what makes someone great in their role

- You close problems. Managers bring them to you, and you get them handled

- You read people and situations well, and you think before you act on sensitive topics

- Managers trust you because your advice is clear, you push back when needed and you follow through

- Shifting priorities and grey areas don’t stress you out, and you keep your sense of humour

What you bring

- 4+ years in HR, including at least 1 as an HR or People Business Partner with your own client group

- Hands-on employee relations experience and a working knowledge of Italian labour law

- Fluent Italian and English

title: Senior Pre-Sales Systems Engineer, Higher Education (IN/MI)
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

Everpure (formerly Pure Storage) is hiring a Senior Pre-Sales Systems Engineer to support our Higher Education business, with a focus on R1 research universities.

R1 institutions are not one customer. A single campus can behave like a dozen different organizations at the same time: central IT running enterprise applications, research computing and HPC teams, genomics and imaging cores, AI and machine learning labs competing for GPU time, an academic medical center with its own rules and its own budget, and faculty groups buying infrastructure directly with grant money. Decisions move through CIOs, research computing directors, principal investigators, sponsored programs offices, procurement, and consortium contract vehicles, often in parallel and not always in agreement.

That environment rewards someone who can hold a lot of context at once, translate between very different audiences, and connect technology to the outcomes these institutions actually care about: time to result for researchers, compliance with sponsor and grant requirements, data that stays usable for a decade or more, and budgets that have to stretch further every year.

You will be the technical lead on these accounts, working alongside account managers, specialists, and partners to build solutions customers can defend internally, both technically and financially.

Location: Michigan or Indiana

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Develop a real understanding of what drives each institution: research priorities, funding cycles, capital versus operating constraints, and who actually makes the decision

• Connect technology, including the Everpure portfolio and the broader ecosystem, to measurable research and institutional outcomes

• Move fluently between principal investigators, research computing staff, central IT, CIOs, finance, and procurement, adapting the conversation to each audience instead of delivering the same presentation

• Build the business case alongside the technical one: total cost of ownership, power and cooling, data center footprint, staff time, and the real cost of the current environment

• Support research workloads end to end, from instrument and sequencer output through HPC and AI pipelines to long-term retention and archive

• Help customers work through data management questions: lifecycle and retention, reproducibility, sponsor and funding agency data sharing expectations, research data governance, and security requirements such as NIST 800-171 and CMMC where they apply

• Partner closely with account managers, specialists, channel partners, and higher education purchasing consortia and contract vehicles

• Take ownership of evaluations, benchmarks, proofs of concept, and system configurations, and secure the technical win

• Capture requirements and translate them into solutions that help institutions grow their research capability rather than just their capacity

• Author responses to RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs, which in this segment are frequent and detailed

• Stay current on the competitive landscape and make sure our positioning reflects it honestly

• Follow market and research computing trends closely enough to bring that thinking back into our organization

• Lead by example living the Pure Values: Persistence, Creativity, Teamwork, Ownership and Customer-first

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

• 8 or more years of relevant experience across technology, solution design, and customer-facing communicatio

title: Brand & Communications Marketer
description:
About Braavo
Braavo Capital has financed mobile app growth for more than ten years. We’ve deployed billions of dollars to hundreds of app companies through revenue-based products - App Store advance payouts, revenue-based financing, and structured credit - underwritten on our own direct integrations with the app stores, ad networks, payment processors, MMPs, and everything in between.
We’re in a phase of rapid expansion, with multiple lines of business and several new product rollouts coming through 2026 and early 2027. As the business grows, we want Braavo to show up more consistently - and more effectively - across the market.
The Role
You’ll own how Braavo shows up externally.
That means building a stronger and more consistent brand across our channels, creating opportunities for Braavo and our team to be part of the right industry conversations, and making sure we show up well at the events and in the communities where our customers spend their time.
Events will be a meaningful part of the job, from major industry conferences to smaller dinners, roundtables, and events we create ourselves. But the role is broader than events: you’ll also work across PR, social, content, partnerships, company announcements, and executive visibility.
This is a hands-on role. You’ll work directly with our founder & CEO and closely with product, originations, and the rest of the team. We need someone who can develop the idea, write the copy, manage the partner or vendor, and get it out the door.
What You’ll Own
Brand and communications

• Help define and maintain a clear, consistent Braavo brand across our website, social channels, events, partnerships, content, and customer communications.

• Own Braavo’s external communications strategy, including company announcements, product launches, media outreach, and ongoing relationships with relevant journalists and publications.

• Identify opportunities for Braavo and our leadership team to participate in industry conversations through press, podcasts, speaking opportunities, contributed content, and commentary.

• Own Braavo’s presence on LinkedIn and other relevant channels, from editorial planning through day-to-day execution.

• Develop customer stories, company news, thought leadership, and other content that gives our market a reason to pay attention to Braavo.

• Work with designers, agencies, freelancers, and PR partners when useful, while owning the story, priorities, and quality internally.

Events and market presence

• Build and manage Braavo’s event calendar across mobile apps, gaming, fintech, and adjacent markets.

• Decide where we should show up - and where we shouldn’t. Evaluate conferences, sponsorships, speaking opportunities, dinners, meetups, and other events based on audience, cost, and business impact.

• Own events end to end: concept, budget, vendors, invitations, sponsorship materials, logistics, on-site execution, and follow-up.

• Develop smaller, high-value events of our own, including founder dinners, CFO roundtables, partner gatherings, and other formats that create meaningful conversations.

• Work closely with the origination team so events and communications support real relationships and opportunities, not just visibility.

Execution and measurement
• Manage a busy calendar of campaigns, events, announcements, and content without needing a large internal team around you.
• Build a practical way to understand what is working across events, content, PR, social, and partnerships.
• Keep things moving. This role will have a lot of parallel projects, and we need someone who can go from idea to execution without losing momentum.
What Success Looks Like

• Months 1-3 . You understand Braavo, our customers, and the markets we operate in, and have a clear point of view on where and how we should be showing up.

• Months 3-6 . We have a stronger and more consistent market presence, a thoughtful event calendar, and a more active communications program across social, press,
